result.topic_en: Calculation relating Euler-type integrals $\int y^\alpha(1-y)^\beta(1-xy)^\gamma dy$ over the intervals $(0,1/x)$, $(1/x,1)$ and $(-\infty,0)$ via analytic continuation and phase factors $e^{\pi i(\ldots)}$, i.e. linear relations among branches of the hypergeometric function.
result.transcription:
$0 \longrightarrow 1$ \quad $-\infty \cdots\cdots 0 \cdot 1$ \quad $\frac{1}{x}$
$\int_0^1 y^\alpha (1-y)^\beta (1-xy)^\gamma dy = Z_1$ \quad $(0,1) + e^{\gamma\pi i}[?] Z_1 \mp (0,\frac{1}{x}) + e^{\gamma\pi i}(\frac{1}{x},1)$ \quad $Z_2 \mp Z_2$
$Z_1 \mp$
$\int_{-\infty}^0 (-y)^\alpha (1-y)^\beta (1-xy)^\gamma dy = Z_2$ \quad $Z_1 \mp e^{2(\beta+\gamma)\pi i} Z_1 - Z_2 \sin\delta\pi\, e^{(\beta+\gamma)\frac{\pi}{2i}}$[?]
$(\frac{1}{x},1)\sin\beta\pi + (0,\frac{1}{x})\sin(\beta+\gamma)\pi - [-\infty-](-\infty,0)\sin\delta\pi$
[-...-] $(-\infty,0) = Z_2$ \quad $Z_2 \mp Z_2$
$0,\frac{1}{x} = Z_1 - e^{-\gamma\pi i}(\frac{1}{x},1)$
$(\frac{1}{x},1)(\sin\beta\pi - e^{-\gamma\pi i}\sin(\beta+\gamma)\pi$
$\frac{e^{\beta\pi i} - e^{-\beta\pi i}}{e^{\beta\pi i} + e^{-(\beta+2\gamma)\pi i}}$ \quad $e^{-(\beta+\gamma)\pi i}\sin\gamma\pi$ \quad $-\sin\gamma\pi\cos(\beta+\gamma)\pi$
$+\sin\gamma\pi \cdot i \sin(\beta+\gamma)\pi$
$(\frac{1}{x},1) - e^{-(\beta+\gamma)\pi i}\sin\gamma\pi + Z_1\sin(\beta+\gamma)\pi - Z_2\sin\delta\pi$
$(\frac{1}{x},1)\sin\gamma\pi = Z_1 e^{(\beta+\gamma)\pi i}\sin(\beta+\gamma)\pi - Z_2\sin\delta\pi\, e^{(\beta+\gamma)\pi i}$
$\frac{e^{2(\beta+\gamma)\pi i} - 1}{2i}$

methods.what: Definition of Euler integral representations of hypergeometric-type functions over (0,1) and (-infinity,0)
Linear relation among integrals over subintervals obtained by contour rotation (sine-weighted relation)
Splitting of the (0,1) integral with phase factor across branch point 1/x
Resulting expression of the (1/x,1) integral in terms of Z_1 and Z_2
